texts.zh:
我们发现自己身处一张巨大的网中。能量沿着网格状的墙壁有节奏地噼啪作响。

一团浓缩的暗物质云悬浮在这张纠结的网的深处。半透明的卷须向外探测能量屏障，接触后会产生火花，然后反冲回来。幽灵般的粒子像有规律地运动着。且不论这团幽灵般的物质是什么，它对我们的存在是没有反应的。
texts.en:
We find ourselves inside of an enormous mesh. Energy crackles rhythmically along its gridlike walls.

A concentrated cloud of dark matter is suspended deep within this tangled web. Translucent tendrils probe outward against the energy barrier, sparking on contact before recoiling back. The ghostly particles move as if patterned. Whatever this spectral mass may be, it has not reacted to our presence.

label.en: Approach the mass of dark matter.
Approach the mass of dark matter.

texts.zh:
这张网覆盖了巨大的面积，完全暴露在周围的空间中。建造它所使用的技术尚不为人所知，但可以合理地假设，它的设计目的是拦截和捕获非固体材料。

当我们环视四周时，只有那个云团在微微颤动。它是网格中唯一的其他存在。

在我们继续观察的过程中，我们观察到一种从矩阵延伸出来的装置。它似乎限制了流入网格的电流的强度。
texts.en:
Covering an enormous surface area, the mesh is fully exposed to the surrounding space. The technology used in its construction is unfamiliar, but it is reasonable to assume that it was designed to intercept and capture non-solid material.

The amorphous cloud stirred slightly as we surveyed our surroundings. It is the only other presence within the mesh.

As we continued our observations, a mechanism was observed extending from the matrix. It seems to be limiting the amplitude of the current flowing into the mesh.

texts.zh:
在我们接近那团虚无缥缈的物质时，我们的[Explorer.GetNetworkName]中探测到一个源自[Leader.GetName]的独立但良性的意识。它似乎正在我们整个集体知识和记忆中搜索着。

这个实体搅动着，一段信息出现在我们的意识中：“我从来没有见到过你们这样的东西，你们是什么呀？”
texts.en:
As we approached the ethereal mass, an independent yet benign consciousness was detected in our [Explorer.GetNetworkName] originating from [Leader.GetName]. It appeared to be searching through our collective knowledge and memories.

The entity stirred, and a message appeared in our minds: "I have never encountered your kind before. What are you?"

texts.zh:
在我们接近那团虚无缥缈的物质时，我们开始在意识中感受到某种存在。看似随机的知识片段被挖掘出来，旧的记忆也被唤起。尽管有侵入性的存在，但我们没有感觉到恶意或不适。

这个实体搅动着，一段信息出现在我们的意识中：“我从来没有见到过你们这样的东西，你们是什么呀？”
texts.en:
As we approached the ethereal mass, we began to feel a presence in our minds. Seemingly random bits of knowledge were dredged up, and old memories stirred. Despite the invasive presence, we sensed no malicious intent or discomfort.

The entity stirred, and a message appeared in our minds: "I have never encountered your kind before. What are you?"

label.en: We are strangers to this place.

label.zh: 我们是来自异世界的探险家。
label.en: We are explorers from another world.

label.en: We are explorers from another world.

texts.zh:
该实体听取了我们的答复，于是另一条信息响起：“又一个好奇的物种，很高兴见到你们。”

“我的同类构成了现实的基石。我们也是流浪者和探索者，对体验宇宙有着极大的兴趣。遗憾的是，另一种生命形式却只是把我们当做物质矿藏；一种随手可得的能量来源，可以随意抓捕和收割。

“我们可以共存，我们的实力相结合足以将科学推向新的边界。”

“在你们的帮助下我可以逃出这个监狱。你们的物种与我不谋而合，我只希望能加入你们的集体意识。我会把我自己的意识融入整个[Leader.Species.GetBrainJunctionName]当中，在所有科学的领域中增进洞见。”
texts.en:
The entity considered our response. Another message rang out: "Another curious species, it is fascinating to meet you."

"My kind makes up the building blocks of reality. We are also wanderers and explorers who take great interest in experiencing the universe. Regrettably, another lifeform saw us as a mere material deposit; a passing fuel source to be captured and harvested."

"We will coexist, with our combined prowess we will push our scientific boundaries to new heights."

"With your help, I can escape this prison. Your kind is compatible with my intentions, I wish only to join your collective consciousness. I will diffuse my mind across your [Leader.Species.GetBrainJunctionName] and enhance your insight in all scientific endeavors."

texts.zh:
一声歇斯底里的哀号穿过内部通讯的本地线路。

这个虚无缥缈的生物对我们的拒绝做出了激烈的反应，它以狂暴的光谱卷须和火花猛烈地拍打着网状结构。

几分钟后，一切平静下来。精疲力竭的实体重新打开了通信。”行吧。如果你不希望我的加入，那么至少赐给我死亡的仁慈。”

它用卷须做了个手势，继续说，“关闭这个装置会激活这个网格，让我的粒子失去活性。被囚禁的日子是一点也过不下去了。”
texts.en:
A primordial wail traversed local lines of internal communication.

The ethereal creature reacted violently to our rejection, lashing out against the meshed structure in a furious wave of spectral tendrils and sparks.

After a few minutes, it settled. The exhausted entity reopened communications. "Very well. If you do not wish for me to join you, then at least give me the mercy of death."

Gesturing with a tendril, it continued, "Deactivating this mechanism will energize this mesh, rendering my particles inert. A life imprisoned is no life at all."

这个虚无缥缈的生物对我们的拒绝做出了激烈的反应，它以狂暴的光谱卷须和火花猛烈地拍打着网状结构。

A primordial wail rang out through the minds of the research team.

The ethereal creature reacted violently to our rejection, lashing out against the meshed structure in a furious wave of spectral tendrils and sparks.

After a few minutes, it settled. The exhausted entity reopened communications. "Very well. If you do not wish for me to join you, then at least give me the mercy of death."

Gesturing with a tendril, it continued, "Deactivating this mechanism will energize this mesh, rendering my particles inert. A life imprisoned is no life at all."

label.zh: 给这个虚无缥缈的生物一个解脱。

texts.zh:
我们关闭了中央的装置，一道高能脉冲席卷整个网络内部。

卷须从幽灵般的云状物中分裂出来，拼命地冲破能量屏障。随着暗物质席卷而来焚毁了整个充能网络，中央的物质团失去了光芒。

一道强烈的蓝色火花点燃了整个结构的中心，把这些颗粒压缩成了原来尺寸的很小一部分。于是火花四溅，暗物质向外泼洒而出，在裂隙探球上覆盖了薄薄的一层。
texts.en:
We deactivated the central mechanism, sending waves of high energy coursing through the internals of the mesh.

Tendrils splintered from the spectral cloud, desperately thrusting against the energy barrier. The central mass grew faint as dark matter surged and burned against the energized mesh.

A violent blue spark ignited in the center of the structure, condensing the particles into a fraction of their original size. The spark then burst and dark matter showered outward, coating the Rift Sphere in a fine film.

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]被绑在诊断台上，意识转移开始了。他不安地扭动着身体，外来的意识逐渐淹没大脑，导致了无法控制的痉挛。幽灵般的实体变成了不稳定能量的漩涡。突然间，一切归于平静，[Leader.GetName]以一种新的姿态站了起来。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] was bound to a diagnostic bench, and the transfer began. They writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably as the foreign consciousness overwhelmed their mind. The ghostly entity became a churning vortex of unstable energy. Suddenly, everything went quiet, and [Leader.GetName] rose with a new demeanor.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

texts.zh:
幽灵般的实体变成了不稳定能量的漩涡。[Leader.GetName]不安地扭动着身体，无法控制地痉挛。突然，他站了起来，脸上带着茫然而又沉思的表情。短暂的停顿之后，他向团队的其他成员做了一个[Leader.GetName]的手势，并示意返回科研船。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
The ghostly entity became a churning vortex of unstable energy. [Leader.GetName] writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably. Suddenly, they rose with a blank yet pensive expression. After a brief pause, they acknowledged the rest of the team with a gesture of their [Leader.GetName] and motioned to return to the Science vessel.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

texts.zh:
数据传输开始后，这个虚无缥缈的实体也开始向自身内部旋转和皱缩。几千年的知识和经验流入了我们的网络之中。基于这些信息的优化也开始实装。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
The ethereal entity swirled and thrashed within itself as the stream of data began. Millennia of knowledge and observations entered the network. Optimizations based on this information were implemented accordingly.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

texts.zh:
随着我们把它的意识吸收进我们的意识织构内，这个虚无缥缈的实体开始向自身内部旋转和皱缩。几千年的知识和经验流入了我们更大的意识之中。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
The ethereal entity swirled and thrashed within itself as we absorbed its consciousness into the mind weave. Millennia of knowledge and observations entered our greater consciousness.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

texts.zh:
我们一做出明确的决定，这个虚无缥缈的生物立刻就建立了通讯线路。暗物质的每一根卷须都缩回了它的中心的物质团。

我们已经部署了无人侦察机和数据基础设施来对这个装置和它的囚犯进行交叉观察。

从我们从裂隙撤退到现在已经过去好几天了，那个实体仍旧一动不动。
texts.en:
Once our decision was made clear, the ethereal creature immediately severed lines of communication. Every tendril of its dark matter withdrew back into its central mass.

We have deployed surveillance drones and data infrastructure for cross-rift observation of this device and its prisoner.

Days have passed since our exit back through the rift, and the entity still has yet to move.

texts.zh:
我们一做出明确的决定，这个虚无缥缈的生物立刻就建立了意识连接。暗物质的每一根卷须都缩回了它的中心的物质团。

我们已经部署了无人侦察机和数据基础设施来对这个装置和它的囚犯进行交叉观察。

从我们从裂隙撤退到现在已经过去好几天了，那个实体仍旧一动不动。
texts.en:
Once our decision was made clear, the ethereal creature immediately severed the mental connection. Every tendril of its dark matter withdrew back into its central mass.

We have deployed surveillance drones and data infrastructure for cross-rift observation of this device and its prisoner.

Days have passed since our exit back through the rift, and the entity still has yet to move.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.System.GetName]的裂隙另一头研究的实体被它所处的维度中的某个未知操作者摧毁了。我们收集的研究数据到此为止。
texts.en: The entity on the side of the rift we were studying in [From.System.GetName] has been neutralized by an unknown actor within its own dimension. The research data we were collecting has ceased.
